does: Looks an effect's name up in a map from name to resource id and answers the effect resource of that id from the resource bank of type 7.

evidence.says: It walks the hash chain for the FixedString key under a read lock, takes the FixedString stored with it and asks the bank of the current resource container for type 7 with it.

questions.ask: Which object owns the map at +0x50 of the global resource manager, and is it filled from EffectName of every effect resource?
